gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sen: Outrun Future spaces its letters far apart, each one traced in a single line. Sen follows in a plain sans with tall lowercase and curves that stop before turning inward, so the heading's synthwave edge sits over a smoother, modern text.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sintony: Outrun Future has no hairline anywhere, just one confident outline from end to end, and it looks authoritative. Sintony sits beside it with a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves that never clog, so the two feel sturdy but still easygoing together.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sofia-sans: Outrun Future brings a synthwave swagger, wide-set letters drawn as a single outline with short ascenders. Sofia Sans backs it with rounded, open, tall lowercase, so if the text feels tight, enlarge the body a notch.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sofia-sans-s: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed has lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Over a long stretch it reads steadily, each curve showing a wide entrance, like channels cut from stencil stock.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sono: Outrun Future makes its diagonals as heavy as its verticals, which gives the wide-spaced heading a blunt, authoritative presence. Sono answers in a sans with tall lowercase and a slightly open a.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-stack-sans-h: Synthwave swagger meets friendly structure here, with Outrun Future's wide-set outline letters leading the way. And Stack Sans Headline, a plain sans with a deep middle band and monoline strokes, gives the pair its strongest quality: crisp clarity even when the text gets tiny.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-stack-sans-n: Authoritative and a bit synthwave, Outrun Future spreads its letters wide. Stack Sans Notch takes over below with open curves and rod-like strokes, a big-bodied sans that grounds the heading's attitude.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-stack-sans-t: Modern and marker-like, Stack Sans Text draws big-bodied lowercase with curve endings kept well apart. But Outrun Future is the one with presence, its wide-set outline letters carrying the synthwave attitude while the plain sans quietly handles the reading.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-sulphur-poin: Sulphur Point has bulky lowercase and a steady, marker-like line, with distinct gaps in its c, e, s and a. Sulphur Point should read comfortably over a long passage, a sans-serif that stays out of the way of Outrun Future's wide, synthwave heading.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans reads open and tall, its x-height rising close to the capitals. Outrun Future does authority best, with a constant pen line and wide-set letters, while TikTok Sans does the modern, spacious sans-serif reading.
